title: Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion Wells Fargo's third-quarter 13F shows 49.6 million IBIT shares worth $2.35 billion at Sept. 30, up from 24.4 million, while its Strategy stake fell about 33% to 1.34 million shares. This post Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
